list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE model != '' UNION ALL SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE model != '') ORDER BY model

list.name: api_key
list.label: Client API Key
list.query: SELECT k AS __text, k AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') AS k FROM llm_gateway.request_log) ORDER BY k

panels.title: Prefill Speed by Model (p50 tok/s, content-TTFT)
panels.description: How fast a model digests your prompt: prompt tokens divided by time-to-first-visible-output, median (p50) over streams with valid timing. Includes migrated history (timing reconstructed from opencode message and part timestamps). Windows under 100 ms are discarded as degenerate.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), speeds AS (SELECT model, round(medianExactIf(prompt_tokens / nullIf(ttft_content_ms, 0) * 1000, ttft_content_ms >= 100), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' AND is_stream = 1 AND ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model) SELECT s.model AS name_str, s.value AS value FROM speeds AS s ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Decode Speed by Model (p50 tok/s, content-TTFT)
panels.description: How fast a model writes once it has started: completion tokens divided by generation time after the first visible output, median (p50). Includes migrated history. Windows under 100 ms are discarded as degenerate.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), speeds AS (SELECT model, round(medianExactIf(completion_tokens / nullIf(duration_ms - ttft_content_ms, 0) * 1000, is_stream = 1 AND ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND duration_ms - ttft_content_ms >= 100), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' AND is_stream = 1 AND ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND duration_ms - ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model) SELECT s.model AS name_str, s.value AS value FROM speeds AS s ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Stream Reliability (share of streams)
panels.description: Stream outcomes over the selected range as a share of streams from models with at least 100 requests: completed, cancels (streams you stopped) and provider aborts (streams the vendor dropped). The three shares sum to 100. Gateway-era rows count each attempt; migrated rows count the final outcome of a generation.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT round(countIf(aborted = 0 AND is_stream = 1) * 100.0 / nullIf(countIf(is_stream = 1), 0), 2) AS "Completed %", round(countIf(aborted = 1) * 100.0 / nullIf(countIf(is_stream = 1), 0), 2) AS "Cancels %", round(countIf(aborted = 2) * 100.0 / nullIf(countIf(is_stream = 1), 0), 2) AS "Provider Aborts %" FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND is_stream = 1 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)

panels.title: Stream Responsiveness (TTFT)
panels.description: How quickly a model starts answering: median and 95th-percentile time to first visible content, plus the share of streams that start within 2 seconds. Streams with no recorded TTFT are excluded; models with under 100 requests are hidden.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT round(quantile(0.5)(ttft_content_ms)) AS "TTFT p50 (ms)", round(quantile(0.95)(ttft_content_ms)) AS "TTFT p95 (ms)", round(countIf(ttft_content_ms <= 2000) * 100.0 / count(), 1) AS "Goodput <=2s (%)" FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND is_stream = 1 AND ttft_content_ms > 0 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)

panels.title: Wasted Tokens & Cost
panels.description: Tokens that bought nothing: generated on streams that got aborted, plus the full output of any generation whose tool call was rejected (guard block, your manual rejection, or a rule denial) - attributed to the generation that made the rejected call, never counted twice. Shown absolute (B/M/K), as a share of all completion tokens, and the dollars spent on them.

targets.rawSql:
WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100),
ev AS (
    SELECT
        u.completion_tokens AS ct,
        u.aborted AS ab,
        s.user_rejections + s.rule_denials + s.guard_blocks AS rej,
        lagInFrame(ct, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY if(r.session_id != '', r.session_id, concat('k:', coalesce(nullIf(r.key_id,''), nullIf(r.api_key_id,''), 'unknown'))) ORDER BY r.timestamp, r.request_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev_ct, lagInFrame(cost, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY if(r.session_id != '', r.session_id, concat('k:', coalesce(nullIf(r.key_id,''), nullIf(r.api_key_id,''), 'unknown'))) ORDER BY r.timestamp, r.request_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev_cost,
        lagInFrame(ab, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY if(r.session_id != '', r.session_id, concat('k:', coalesce(nullIf(r.key_id,''), nullIf(r.api_key_id,''), 'unknown'))) ORDER BY r.timestamp, r.request_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev_ab
    FROM llm_gateway.request_log r
    INNER JOIN llm_gateway.usage_log u ON u.request_id = r.request_id
    INNER JOIN llm_gateway.request_signals s ON s.request_id = r.request_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
      AND r.request_id != ''
      AND coalesce(nullIf(r.key_id,''), nullIf(r.api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote})
      AND u.model IN (${model:singlequote})
      AND u.model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        sum(if(aborted > 0, completion_tokens, 0)) AS wasted_tokens,
        sum(completion_tokens) AS total_tokens,
        round(sumIf(cost, aborted > 0), 2) AS wasted_cost
    FROM llm_gateway.usage_log
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote})
      AND model IN (${model:singlequote})
      AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)
),
rejw AS (
    SELECT sumIf(prev_ct, rej > 0 AND prev_ab = 0) AS rej_wasted, sumIf(prev_cost, rej > 0 AND prev_ab = 0) AS rej_cost FROM ev
)
SELECT
    multiIf(wasted_tokens + rej_wasted >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round((wasted_tokens + rej_wasted) / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'),
            wasted_tokens + rej_wasted >= 1000000, concat(toString(round((wasted_tokens + rej_wasted) / 1000000, 2)), 'M'),
            wasted_tokens + rej_wasted >= 1000, concat(toString(round((wasted_tokens + rej_wasted) / 1000, 2)), 'K'),
            toString(wasted_tokens + rej_wasted)) AS "Wasted Tokens",
    concat(toString(round(100 * (wasted_tokens + rej_wasted) / nullIf(total_tokens, 0), 2)), '%') AS "Wasted % of Total",
    concat('$', toString(floor(round((wasted_cost + rej_cost) * 100) / 100)), '.', leftPad(toString(round((wasted_cost + rej_cost) * 100) % 100), 2, '0')) AS "Cost of Wasted Tokens"
FROM agg, rejw

panels.title: Cost & Time per Completed Response (avg)
panels.description: Averages over completed (non-aborted) responses, NOT p50: budget math needs the mean, and long tails are real spend. Mean cost per completed response, mean wall time per generation, and how many completed responses the numbers rest on.

targets.rawSql:
WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100)
SELECT
    concat('$', toString(floor(round(cpc * 100) / 100)), '.', leftPad(toString(round(cpc * 100) % 100), 2, '0')) AS "Cost per Completed Response (avg)",
    concat(toString(round(tpc, 1)), 's') AS "Avg Time per Completed",
    multiIf(n >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(n / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'), n >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(n / 1000000, 2)), 'M'), n >= 1000, concat(toString(round(n / 1000, 2)), 'K'), toString(n)) AS "Completed Responses"
FROM (
    SELECT
        sumIf(cost, aborted = 0) / nullIf(countIf(aborted = 0), 0) AS cpc,
        avgIf(duration_ms, aborted = 0 AND duration_ms > 0) / 1000 AS tpc,
        countIf(aborted = 0) AS n
    FROM llm_gateway.usage_log
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote})
      AND model IN (${model:singlequote})
      AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)
)
